# generated by mBlock5 for CyberPi
# codes make you happy

import gamepad, mbot2, event, time, cyberpi
import time

def Shoot():
    if gamepad.is_key_pressed('R1'):
      mbot2.motor_set(-100,"M2")

    else:
      if gamepad.is_key_pressed('R2'):
        mbot2.motor_set(-80,"M2")

      else:
        mbot2.motor_stop("M2")

@event.start
def on_start():
    mbot2.servo_drive(0,180,120,70)
    while True:
      Move_Robot()
      Shoot()
      Gripper()

def Move_Robot():
    if gamepad.get_joystick('Ly') > 5:
      mbot2.forward(150)

    else:
      if gamepad.get_joystick('Ly') < -5:
        mbot2.backward(150)

      else:
        if gamepad.get_joystick('Rx') > 5:
          mbot2.turn_right(150)

        else:
          if gamepad.get_joystick('Rx') < -5:
            mbot2.turn_left(150)

          else:
            mbot2.EM_stop("ALL")

def Gripper():
    if gamepad.is_key_pressed('N4'):
      mbot2.servo_set(120,"S3")
      mbot2.servo_set(70,"S4")

    else:
      if gamepad.is_key_pressed('N1'):
        mbot2.servo_set(75,"S3")
        mbot2.servo_set(105,"S4")

      else:
        if gamepad.is_key_pressed('N2'):
          mbot2.servo_set(0,"S2")
          time.sleep(1)
          mbot2.servo_set(120,"S3")
          mbot2.servo_set(70,"S4")

        else:
          if gamepad.is_key_pressed('N3'):
            mbot2.servo_set(180,"S2")

          else:
            if gamepad.is_key_pressed('Start'):
              mbot2.servo_set(110,"S2")

            else:
              # DO SOMETHING
              pass

def Lift():
    if gamepad.is_key_pressed('L1'):
      mbot2.motor_set(60,"M1")

    else:
      if gamepad.is_key_pressed('L2'):
        mbot2.motor_set(60,"M1")

      else:
        mbot2.EM_stop("ALL")
